info.title: Whisipedia API
info.description:
Read API of a private offline library. Everything is served from local storage; the server makes no
outbound connections. Errors always use the envelope `{"error": {"code", "message"}}`; `503` (with
`Retry-After`) means the library storage is busy or still loading.

List endpoints use opaque cursors: pass `next_cursor` back as `cursor`. The change feed uses its own
cursor (`since`). Document ids are `wsp:<source_id>/<native_id>`; in URL paths a doc id is ONE
percent-encoded segment (`/v1/documents/wsp%3Arfc%2F9110`), as produced by `encodeURIComponent`.

days.title: Days
days.description: Days since the streak began (0 while a critical alert is open).

reset_by.title: Reset By
reset_by.description: What began it: the newest critical alert or owner intervention.

critical_open.title: Critical Open
critical_open.description: Critical alerts open now (the streak cannot grow).

slo_failing.title: Slo Failing
slo_failing.description: Sources behind their freshness SLO now.

AutonomyStatus.title: AutonomyStatus
AutonomyStatus.description: The plan's phase-5 exit (PLAN §14): 30 days unattended, every SLO met, no manual repairs.

title.title: Title
title.description: Document title, if the document is known.

cursor.title: Cursor
cursor.description: Opaque. Pass as `since` to continue after these items.

doc_id.title: Doc Id
doc_id.description: Null when the entry is a whole site.

trail.title: Trail
trail.description: Ancestors and this node, Top excluded.

total.title: Total
total.description: Documents in this category when `entries` lists only the best known of them (the catalog keeps a bounded list per category); null when `entries` is complete.

DocKind.title: DocKind
DocKind.description: What kind of site a source is: drives result filters, badges and the start page (PLAN §10.3).

text.title: Text
text.description: Plain text. Null for an HTML page unless asked for with `fields=text`; always set when `format` is `text`.

content_hash.title: Content Hash
content_hash.description: BLAKE3 of the normalized text: the content-version id.

links.title: Links
links.description: Outbound links and whether each is held locally.

format.title: Format
format.description: `html` when the original HTML is available (then `html` is set).

html.title: Html
html.description: Original HTML with images rewritten to `/v1/assets/…` and internal links to `wsp://` addresses. Untrusted: clients must sanitize it.

has_history.title: Has History
has_history.description: True if the history has more than one version.

currency.title: Currency
currency.description: Edition status for document collections: current, superseded, historical, rescinded or withdrawn-from-index (PLAN D13). Absent for sources without editions.

banner.title: Banner
banner.description: Reader warning to show above the document, e.g. 'Historical document — methods may be outdated or unsafe.' (PLAN D13). Absent when there is nothing to warn about.

copies.title: Copies
copies.description: Other copies of the same work (registry access.copies): an illustrated edition, a complete rendering of a page whose text here is partial.

rendition.description: Set when `html` is another source's page for this title; `vault` then describes that page's file.

original.description: The stored original file, for documents refined from one (PDFs, maps).

href.title: Href
href.description: The link as recorded by the Refinery (a doc id or a native URL).

target.title: Target
target.description: Local doc id it resolves to, or null if not in the library.

completed.title: Completed
completed.description: Files reported complete in the lane's log.

last_completed.title: Last Completed
last_completed.description: File name of the newest completion.

progress.title: Progress
progress.description: Latest progress line, if the lane is running.

DownloadLane.title: DownloadLane
DownloadLane.description: A bulk download lane (aria2 session) from the bootstrap downloads.

message.title: Message
message.description: Human-readable explanation. Not stable; do not parse.

ErrorResponse.title: ErrorResponse
ErrorResponse.description: Every non-2xx response has this shape.

href.title: Href
href.description: The link that is not in the library.

generation_id.title: Generation Id
generation_id.description: Snapshot handle, e.g. `2026-10-01`. Immutable once sealed.

current.title: Current
current.description: True if this is the promoted generation.

sources.title: Sources
sources.description: Number of sources in the registry.

highlights.title: Highlights
highlights.description: `[start, end)` ranges into `snippet`, in Unicode code points.

provenance_invalid.title: Provenance Invalid
provenance_invalid.description: Generations whose PROVENANCE.json fails its signature.

IntegrityStatus.title: IntegrityStatus
IntegrityStatus.description: Source integrity (ADR-0009): provenance, verification channels, holds and origin drift.

orchestrator_state.title: Orchestrator State
orchestrator_state.description: False until the orchestrator has created its state DB.

trawler.description: Null until the trawler has run.

OpsStatus.title: OpsStatus
OpsStatus.description: Operations data for the System Monitor (PLAN §12.6); every part tolerates missing state.

inline.title: Inline
inline.description: True if a browser shows it itself (PDF, JPEG, PNG); else it downloads.

preview_url.title: Preview Url
preview_url.description: A JPEG of an image or map scan (`/v1/files/{doc_id}/preview`).

OriginalFile.title: OriginalFile
OriginalFile.description: The stored file a collection document was refined from (a PDF, a scanned map, an archive).

why.title: Why
why.description: e.g. "the illustrated edition", "the complete text as rendered by Wikisource".

OtherCopy.title: OtherCopy
OtherCopy.description: Another copy of the same work in the library, and why a reader might prefer it.

available.title: Available
available.description: False when par2 is not installed or parity is off.

states.title: States
states.description: Generations per parity state (none, partial, sidecar, ...).

random_sources.title: Random Sources
random_sources.description: Sources that have pages to pick at random.

cursor.title: Cursor
cursor.description: Change-feed cursor these items are current to: follow `/v1/changes/stream?since=` from here for live updates. Null if the feed is empty.

Rendition.title: Rendition
Rendition.description:
Where the HTML on screen comes from when another source renders this document (e.g. the
Wikipedia dump's text shown with the Kiwix ZIM's page).

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: `client`: a page drawn entirely by the Navigator (history, hotlist, …).

href.title: Href
href.description: API resource to fetch; null for pages rendered client-side.

fraction.title: Fraction
fraction.description: Share of known files verified within the scrub cycle.

next_offset.title: Next Offset
next_offset.description: Offset of the next page, if any.

total.title: Total
total.description: Results for the query (and `kind`), counted in the same ranked list the page comes from (at most 200; a lower bound if `total_is_estimate`).

timings_ms.title: Timings Ms
timings_ms.description: Diagnostics: milliseconds per stage. `oracle.*` are the ranking pipeline's own, from the run that produced the results (a cached result repeats them). Not a contract; stages may change.

facets.title: Facets
facets.description: Results per kind in the same ranked list, ignoring the `kind` filter: filtering by a kind shows exactly its count. Kinds with no results are left out.

navigate_to.title: Navigate To
navigate_to.description: Doc id when the query names one page (`rfc 9110`, `wikipedia Alan Turing`).

instant.title: Instant
instant.description: Instant-answer box (definition, fact, map). Reserved: not produced yet.

did_you_mean.title: Did You Mean
did_you_mean.description: A spelling correction from the library's vocabulary, offered when results are sparse or a query word is unknown.

scope.description: Set when the query named a site (`rfc 9110`): totals and facets count that scope.

low_confidence.title: Low Confidence
low_confidence.description: True when retrieval found little or nothing.

scope_note.title: Scope Note
scope_note.description: Set when a requested source is not searched itself but through another copy (e.g. the Wikipedia ZIM through the indexed dump of the same articles).

site.title: Site
site.description: The site named in the query, as typed (`rfc` in `rfc 9110`).

fallback.title: Fallback
fallback.description: True when those sources had nothing for the query and the whole library was searched.

stale.title: Stale
stale.description: True if older than the cadence, or active with nothing promoted.

SourceHealth.title: SourceHealth
SourceHealth.description: Status lamp: ``offline`` = nothing promoted, ``degraded`` = current generation failed scrub.

status.title: Status
status.description: Registry lifecycle status. See `health` for the status lamp.

address.title: Address
address.description: Navigator address of the source's site, e.g. `wsp://rfc`.

kind.description: Derived from the first registry domain.

as_of.title: As Of
as_of.description: When the current generation was sealed.

home_doc_id.title: Home Doc Id
home_doc_id.description: Landing document of the site, if any.

readable.title: Readable
readable.description: The site has something to read (held, with documents or served from ZIM archives); planned sources and raw data are not linked as sites.

related.title: Related
related.description: Source ids sharing a domain (webring bar).

channel.title: Channel
channel.description: Weakest checksum-channel status of the last checked release: `independent`, `same-origin`, `unavailable`, `mismatch` or `never checked` (ADR-0009).

verdict.title: Verdict
verdict.description: Strongest integrity action: info, alert, hold, quarantine.

next_cursor.title: Next Cursor
next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` for the next page.

lag_days.title: Lag Days
lag_days.description: How long upstream has had a newer release than ours; 0 if current.

within_slo.title: Within Slo
within_slo.description: Null when upstream was never observed.

ledger_ok.title: Ledger Ok
ledger_ok.description: Result of replaying the ledger hash chain; null until the first replay has finished.

problem.title: Problem
problem.description: The first problem found on the page.

failed.title: Failed
failed.description: Pages with at least one problem, in all.

with_defects.title: With Defects
with_defects.description: Pages that work but have a missing image or a link into nothing.

catalog_without_link.title: Catalog Without Link
catalog_without_link.description: Catalog cards that do not link their book directly.

recent.title: Recent
recent.description: The latest problems, newest first (at most 20).

TrawlerStatus.title: TrawlerStatus
TrawlerStatus.description: What the trawler (navigator/scripts/trawl.mjs) found opening pages nobody had opened yet.

path.title: Path
path.description: File (or generation directory) relative to the vault root.

manifest.title: Manifest
manifest.description: `MANIFEST.json` that covers the file, relative to the vault root.

entry.title: Entry
entry.description: Entry inside a container file, e.g. a ZIM path.

sha256.title: Sha256
sha256.description: Manifest entry hash of the file.

blake3.title: Blake3
blake3.description: Manifest entry hash of the file.

VaultLocation.title: VaultLocation
VaultLocation.description: Where the bytes live, for "View Source Data" and the direct route (PLAN §7, §10.2).
